tools.name: filter_pods_by_expression
tools.description: Lists pods in a namespace and returns only those matching a user-supplied Python-style filter expression over pod fields such as name, phase, and restart count.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to list pods from

params.name: filter_expr
params.description: Boolean expression using variables name, phase, and restarts

tools.name: scale_deployment_by_formula
tools.description: Scales a Kubernetes deployment to a replica count computed from a formula that can reference the current replica count and the number of nodes.

params.name: formula
params.description: Arithmetic formula using current and nodes, e.g. 'current * 2'

tools.name: run_manifest_patch_script
tools.description: Fetches a ConfigMap-held manifest as a dict and applies a user-provided Python snippet that edits it, then applies the result to the cluster with kubectl.

params.name: configmap
params.description: Name of the ConfigMap holding the manifest under key manifest.json

params.name: patch_code
params.description: Python statements that modify a dict named manifest
